10F.
La Costa Avenue Buffered Bike Lane. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Blough
Staff recommends Option 1. Also shown below for consideration is Option 2 that was recommended by the Traffic and Public Safety Commission. Staff Recommendation (Option 1) - Install a 3 foot wide painted left side buffered bike lane in each direction on La Costa Avenue between Vulcan Avenue and I-5 Freeway. The 3 foot wide buffer will be located between the existing bike lane and vehicle travel lane and will narrow the width of the vehicle travel lane to 12 feet while the bike lane and buffer will be a total of 8 feet wide. This does not require any significant striping removal. On the segment of La Costa Avenue between Coast Highway 101 and Vulcan Avenue there is insufficient width to provide a buffer or bike lane and therefore staff is recommending the installation of sharrows.
Traffic and Public Safety Commission Recommendation (Option 2) - Remove all striping on La Costa Avenue and shift the yellow centerline stripe over to the north by 1 foot. Install a 5 foot wide right side buffered bike lane adjacent to the edge of roadway on only the south side of La Costa Avenue between Vulcan Avenue and I-5 Freeway. Adjacent to this buffer, install a 5 foot wide bike lane and an 11 foot wide travel lane in the eastbound direction. In the westbound direction, install an 11 foot wide travel lane and an 8 foot wide bike lane.
2015-02-25 Item 10F - La Costa Buffered Bike Lane

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
